CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository hosts the Unraid Community Applications template for **MOSBot** — a headless Twitch bot that automatically participates in *Marbles On Stream* lobbies across many live channels, with a web dashboard for monitoring and control.
Designed to run as a single container on Unraid, alongside (not instead of) the Channel-Points Miner.
- **Source code:** https://github.com/patriqcs/mosbot - **Container image:** `ghcr.io/patriqcs/mosbot:latest` - **Support:** https://forums.unraid.net/topic/198953-support-mosbot-marbles-on-stream-auto-play-twitch-bot-with-web-dashboard/
For bug reports and feature requests, please open a GitHub issue at https://github.com/patriqcs/mosbot/issues. For installation and configuration help, use the Unraid forum support thread linked above.
